tools/pyUANamespace/README.md:51:Blacklisting removes nodes, which means that any other nodes referring to these nodes will contain invalid references. If a namespace should be generated that can use all datatypes, objectstypes, etc., but should only print specific nodes into the C Header, a set of nodes can be ignored. This will cause the compiler to use them in the linked namespace where other nodes can use them (e.g. in buildEncodingRules()), but they will not appear as part of the header file.
